formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous oxyethylene-oxymethylene copolymer, -[(CH2CH2O)n-CH2-O-]m, with n varying randomly around 9 and m about 600. Chemically similar to linear PEO but with randomly-spaced oxymethylene (-CH2O-) units inserted; remains amorphous (much less depressed impedance semicircle than semicrystalline PEO). Sample supplied undoped by C.V. Nicholas (University of Manchester). This record is the undoped (no LiClO4) baseline, labelled 'Un:1' (i.e. O:Li -> infinity) in Fig. 4 and Li:O=0 in Fig. 5.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Fig. 4 Arrhenius plot ('Un:1' curve, undoped) is visibly curved (non-linear), consistent with VFT-type behaviour typical of amorphous polymer electrolytes, but no numerical Ea, prefactor or T0 are given in the text.
formulations.Notes: Conductivity values digitised from Fig. 5 (log10 sigma vs Li:O ratio, row Li:O=0), marked '~' in the source table; sanity-checked against the lowest ('Un:1') curve of the Fig. 4 Arrhenius plot image, which shows the same qualitative trend (lowest conductivity of the series, rising with T).
formulations.Reference: E. Linden, J.R. Owen, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 994-1000

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous oxyethylene-oxymethylene copolymer, -[(CH2CH2O)n-CH2-O-]m, n~9 (random), m~600; chemically similar to linear PEO. Doped with LiClO4 at an O:Li ratio of 64:1 (dissolved in acetonitrile with LiClO4, solvent evaporated under dry argon, then vacuum dried).
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Fig. 4 Arrhenius plot (64:1 curve) is curved (non-Arrhenius/VFT-like) but no numerical Ea, prefactor or T0 are reported in the text.
formulations.Notes: Conductivity values digitised from Fig. 5 (log10 sigma vs Li:O ratio, row Li:O~0.015, corresponding to O:Li=64:1), marked '~' in source table; cross-checked qualitatively against the '64:1' curve in Fig. 4, which shows the second-lowest conductivity of the series.
formulations.Reference: E. Linden, J.R. Owen, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 994-1000

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous oxyethylene-oxymethylene copolymer, -[(CH2CH2O)n-CH2-O-]m, n~9 (random), m~600; chemically similar to linear PEO. Doped with LiClO4 at O:Li=24:1, the composition near the conductivity maximum and used for the detailed impedance studies (thin-cell Fig. 1a/1b, thick-cell Fig. 3, lithium-electrode Fig. 6).
formulations.Transference notes: No transference number measured. Fig. 6 (thick-cell, Li metal electrodes, this 24:1 sample) shows a second low-frequency 'interfacial impedance' semicircle, attributed to a reaction layer between polymer and Li metal, indicating unresolved Li compatibility issues.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Fig. 4 Arrhenius plot (24:1 curve, most conductive of series) is curved (non-Arrhenius/VFT-like); no numerical Ea, prefactor or T0 given in text.
formulations.Notes: Conductivities digitised ('~') from Fig. 5 row Li:O~0.04 (O:Li=24:1); this is the conductivity maximum vs concentration. Cross-check: Fig. 1a/b (thin cell) intercept ~205 ohm and Fig. 3 (thick cell) intercept ~24000 ohm both give room-T conductivity ~1-4x10^-5 S/cm, consistent order of magnitude with Fig.5's 25C value; exact T for Figs.1/3 not stated so not assigned to a temperature field.
formulations.Reference: E. Linden, J.R. Owen, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 994-1000

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous oxyethylene-oxymethylene copolymer, -[(CH2CH2O)n-CH2-O-]m, n~9 (random), m~600; chemically similar to linear PEO. Doped with LiClO4 at O:Li=16:1.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Fig. 4 Arrhenius plot (16:1 curve) is curved (non-Arrhenius/VFT-like); no numerical Ea, prefactor or T0 are given in the text.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous oxyethylene-oxymethylene copolymer, -[(CH2CH2O)n-CH2-O-]m, n~9 (random), m~600; chemically similar to linear PEO. Doped with LiClO4 at O:Li=8:1. This is the composition for which frequency-dependent conductivity/dielectric constant data are shown (Fig. 2, thin cell).
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Fig. 4 Arrhenius plot (8:1 curve) is curved (non-Arrhenius/VFT-like); no numerical Ea, prefactor or T0 are given in the text.
formulations.Notes: Conductivities digitised ('~') from Fig. 5 row Li:O=0.125 (O:Li=8:1). Fig. 2 (freq-dependent log sigma/log Er, same 8:1 sample) shows a dc plateau of log sigma ~ -6.1 to -6.2 (~7x10^-7 S/cm), broadly consistent with a room-T Fig.5 reading; exact T for Fig.2 not stated, so not assigned to a temperature field. Dielectric constant varies far less than conductivity with frequency.
formulations.Reference: E. Linden, J.R. Owen, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 994-1000

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Conventional (semicrystalline) linear PEO doped with LiClO4 at O:Li=8:1, used only as a comparison sample (Fig. 1c) to contrast impedance semicircle depression against the amorphous copolymer at the same nominal salt ratio. Prep details (solvent, drying) for this comparison sample are not given; Experimental section describes only the amorphous copolymer samples.
formulations.Notes: Characterised only via impedance spectrum (Fig. 1c, thin cell, 100um/3.6cm^2), shown for comparison: semicircle much more depressed than the amorphous copolymer's (Fig. 1a/b), consistent with heterogeneous conduction in semicrystalline PEO. Approx resistance intercept ~64000 ohm (marked '~') implies conductivity ~4x10^-8 S/cm, but measurement T not stated so not assigned to a temperature field.
formulations.Reference: E. Linden, J.R. Owen, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 994-1000
